import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from view import View

def test_basic_begin_finish():
    v = View()
    r1 = v.begin("q1")
    assert r1 == 1
    assert v.loading == True
    assert v.error is None
    result = v.finish(r1, ["row1", "row2"])
    assert result == True
    assert v.rows == ["row1", "row2"]
    assert v.loading == False

def test_monotonically_increasing_ids():
    v = View()
    r1 = v.begin("q1")
    r2 = v.begin("q2")
    r3 = v.begin("q3")
    assert r1 == 1
    assert r2 == 2
    assert r3 == 3

def test_finish_old_request_id():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.begin("q2")  # active is now 2
    result = v.finish(1, ["old rows"])  # should fail
    assert result == False
    # rows should still be empty or from previous

def test_finish_duplicate_request_id():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    r1 = v.seq  # 1
    result1 = v.finish(r1, ["first finish"])
    assert result1 == True
    result2 = v.finish(r1, ["second finish"])
    assert result2 == False

def test_begin_clears_error():
    v = View()
    v.error = "old error"
    v.begin("new query")
    assert v.error is None

def test_begin_keeps_rows():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, ["old rows"])
    v.begin("q2")  # clear error but keep rows until valid finish
    # rows should still be ["old rows"]
    assert v.rows == ["old rows"]

def test_finish_updates_rows():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.finish(1, ["new rows"])
    assert v.rows == ["new rows"]

def test_finish_returns_false_when_not_active():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.begin("q2")  # active is 2
    result = v.finish(1, ["wrong rows"])
    assert result == False
    assert v.rows == []  # rows should not be updated

def test_notes_preserved():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.notes["job1"] = "note1"
    v.begin("q2")
    v.notes["job2"] = "note2"
    assert v.notes["job1"] == "note1"
    assert v.notes["job2"] == "note2"

def test_finish_does_not_clear_notes():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.notes["job1"] = "note1"
    v.finish(1, ["rows"])
    assert v.notes["job1"] == "note1"

def test_finish_accepts_rows_copy():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    rows = ["a", "b", "c"]
    v.finish(1, rows)
    assert v.rows == ["a", "b", "c"]
    # Modify original
    rows.append("d")
    assert v.rows == ["a", "b", "c"]  # should be copy

def test_loading_boolean_exposed():
    v = View()
    assert v.loading == False
    v.begin("q1")
    assert v.loading == True
    v.finish(1, ["rows"])
    assert v.loading == False

def test_multiple_begin_calls():
    v = View()
    ids = []
    for i in range(5):
        ids.append(v.begin(f"q{i}"))
    assert ids == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

def test_finish_with_different_request_ids():
    v = View()
    v.begin("q1")
    v.begin("q2")
    v.begin("q3")
    # Only q3 should be accepted
    assert v.finish(3, ["q3 rows"]) == True
    assert v.finish(2, ["q2 rows"]) == False
    assert v.finish(1, ["q1 rows"]) == False
    assert v.rows == ["q3 rows"]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_basic_begin_finish()
    test_monotonically_increasing_ids()
    test_finish_old_request_id()
    test_finish_duplicate_request_id()
    test_begin_clears_error()
    test_begin_keeps_rows()
    test_finish_updates_rows()
    test_finish_returns_false_when_not_active()
    test_notes_preserved()
    test_finish_does_not_clear_notes()
    test_finish_accepts_rows_copy()
    test_loading_boolean_exposed()
    test_multiple_begin_calls()
    test_finish_with_different_request_ids()
    print("All tests passed!")
